Virtual Assets Rulebook Update

The Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority has updated rulebook requirements for virtual asset service providers. Licensed entities must maintain AML controls, market conduct policies, client asset safeguards, and governance procedures.

The regulatory update applies to exchange services, broker-dealer services, custody services, advisory services, and transfer and settlement services. Compliance officers must review internal policies against the updated rulebook.

VASPs should retain evidence of implementation and escalate material gaps to senior management and compliance governance committees.
